narrative: Material PL1__MCB20CA0 exhibits a smooth demand pattern (CV=31.3%) with mean daily demand of 376.18 units and no detectable trend. Lead times average 4.02 days with moderate variability (CV=39.1%), and lead-time variability drives 86.2% of total demand uncertainty during replenishment. The chosen (r,Q) EOQ-with-safety-stock policy is well-suited to this continuous, stable demand profile; safety stock is set to 1,048 units (z=1.645 at 95% SL) and the reorder point to 2,561 units. The unconstrained EOQ of 3,538 units is capped at 2,011 units by the 3,059-unit storage limit, driving 100% capacity utilisation and flagging the need for a storage review.
